about.description: Colb Anthropic (CANP) is a Swiss-law tracker certificate issued by the BVI-domiciled CPT Trust and manufactured by Geneva-based Colb Asset SA, intended to give qualified investors economic exposure to Anthropic pre-IPO shares held via SPVs. Announced but not yet issued: on-chain supply is zero as of 2026-06-11. Tokens are SSPA-type-1300 tracker certificates (Swiss DLT Act ledger-based securities. No ISIN, unlisted, not FINMA-supervised). Mint and redemption (settled in Colb's USC stablecoin) are KYC-gated to professional investors while transfers are unrestricted. Underlying shares are held on the cap table or via SPVs whose composition is NDA-gated and not publicly attested. Valuations are issuer-set and investors bear issuer credit risk.
